result.title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
result.summary: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExtractBench Pro，用确定性合成文档生成框架构造 100 篇长尾文档、覆盖六种困难抽取模式，并评测十个 coding agent 与八种抽取 API 的准确率、grounding 与整篇无误率及成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 schema 引导的视觉文档 grounding 指标与 agent trace 失败分析（图表关系恢复、文档特定定义应用）可供核查「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」及视觉旁路问题，但任务本身偏抽取而非 latent 推理，需进一步判断可迁移性。
